title: The words we'll use all year
text:
Vocabulary

≈ **15 min**

The words we'll use all year

TermMeaning

PositionWhere something is, measured from a chosen zero point

DistanceThe full length of the path traveled

DisplacementChange in position — from start to finish

ScalarAn amount with size only

VectorAn amount with size **and** direction

Copy these five words and meanings into your notes.

title: Choose a zero and a direction
text:
I do · locate first

Target K1 Pairs

**Choose a zero** and a direction

The door is **0 m**. Right is positive.

A position of **−2 m** means **2 m** left of the door.

Follow the cart

Follow the cart: -2, 0, 2 m. These are locations. A negative location does not tell us which way something moves.

These numbers tell where things are. A minus sign alone does not tell which way they move.

Target K1

Worked route: out and back

Start at **0 m**, walk to **4 m**, then return to **1 m**.

Distance = |**4** − **0**| + |**1** − **4**| = **7 m**

Displacement = **1** − **0** = **+1 m**
